AVCaptureDevice.self.addObserver(self, forKeyPath: systemPreferredKeyPath, options: [.new], context: nil) } override func observeValue(forKeyPath keyPath: String?, of object: Any?, change: [NSKeyValueChangeKey: Any]?, context: UnsafeMutableRawPointer?) { switch keyPath { case systemPreferredKeyPath: // Update the observer's system-preferred camera value. systemPreferredCamera = change?[.newKey] as?
